"""Continue retained independent body histories; no accepted-prefix replay.

Explicit bench effort release at 250ms separates constant-input event paths.
The body's forces, admission laws and all error limits remain unchanged.
"""
from pathlib import Path
import hashlib
import sys

HERE=Path(__file__).resolve()
ACCEPTED=Path('/tmp/a1-body-radau3-solved-genesis-20260927.py')
ACCEPTED_SHA='6f6999a513f752fb5c23946cde660ddadac5de2e86bd39302255fd4110f13636'
ABI=Path('/tmp/guala-body-velocity.uw41fxqs/python/guala_body_interval.cpython-311-x86_64-linux-gnu.so')
ABI_SHA='04c168a94573c7b3282b9f1ea00e5821a00b8126357b8e6eb7f0d38b4b67a4f9'
RADAU=Path('/tmp/guala-body-history.wufobn6a/python/guala_body_radau.cpython-311-x86_64-linux-gnu.so')
RADAU_SHA='37a8624240d9e81f7911f9cf780e34beedcddffb9b2f45a9b8f5021476071dba'
SOURCE_SHA='2353d94561e2c2249d4a04fe89f95f7f384fccc60f3b34b50ae48cd3e4e3fe83'
PARENTS={
 'FB-01aj-radau3-solved-genesis.json':'c243a427cb3344d7ff1ebde75f1aaef353e4fad4d50ad2d1e791c3a1e974e85d',
 'FB-01aj-radau3-continuation-1.json':'0dde7d4af486bf88ff89de9c91b84a7c0161fda16c8ec0329c3367b89ab645af',
 'FB-01aj-finer-independent-history-daf2ed50914e.json':'ad9c3eb0b17518c70e52a991b76e10bf4d96f116838e870b7025b0de575a908c',
}
SCHEMA_OUT='guala.functional-body.paired-load-release.v1'
TARGET_NAME='FB-01aj-paired-load-release.json'
RESUME=None


def require(condition,message):
    if not condition:raise RuntimeError(message)


def diagnostic():
    global CPU_LIMIT,MAX_TRIALS
    source=ACCEPTED.read_bytes()
    require(hashlib.sha256(source).hexdigest()==ACCEPTED_SHA,'observer source changed')
    marker='\nresult=dict(schema=SCHEMA,completed=False'
    require(source.decode().count(marker)==1,'observer boundary changed')
    exec(compile(source.decode().split(marker,1)[0],'<accepted independent mechanics/observer>','exec'),globals())
    CPU_LIMIT,MAX_TRIALS=50.,30000
    result=dict(schema=SCHEMA_OUT,completed=False,failure=None,first_failure=None,
        mounted=False,full_body_qualification=False,continuum_enclosure=False,
        scope='retained50us/25us histories, zero gravity, load until250ms then release until500ms',
        parent_receipt=None if RESUME is None else dict(file=RESUME[0],sha256=RESUME[1]),
        samples=[],prior_sample_count=0,prior_cpu_seconds=0.,resumed_inputs=[],
        last_common_time_s=None,event_states={},closed_segments=[],
        release_records=[],segment_start_s=0.,comparisons=[])
    lanes=[];errors=Errors();prior={}
    mj.mj_forward=forward

    def load(name,sha):
        b=Path('docs/evidence',name).read_bytes()
        require(hashlib.sha256(b).hexdigest()==sha,'parent receipt differs')
        r=json.loads(b)
        require(r['measurement_recorded'] and r['health_error'] is None and
                r.get('operational_error') is None and r['execution']['exit_code']==0 and
                not r['execution']['timed_out'],'parent execution envelope unavailable')
        q=r['raw_measurement'];b=zlib.decompress(base64.b64decode(q['payload_zlib_base64'],validate=True))
        require(len(b)==q['raw_bytes'] and hashlib.sha256(b).hexdigest()==q['raw_sha256'],'parent payload differs')
        return json.loads(b)

    def paths(rows,initial):
        sequence,brackets=[plain_domain(initial)],[]
        for row in rows:
            require(plain_domain(row['before_domain'])==sequence[-1],'actual event history discontinuous')
            for event in chronological_events(row):
                require(plain_domain(event['before_domain'])==sequence[-1],'sampled event predecessor differs')
                sequence.append(plain_domain(event['after_domain']))
                brackets.append(dict(start_s=event['start_s'],end_s=event['end_s']))
        return tuple(sequence),brackets

    def restore(saved,label,nominal,control):
        lane=Lane(label,nominal,control);lanes.append(lane);c=lane.c
        require(lane.genesis==saved['genesis_base64'] and nominal==saved['nominal_dt_s'],
                'retained anatomy/control/genesis changed')
        entry=dict(label=label,expected_state_base64=saved['state_base64'],
            expected_time_s=saved['time_s'],expected_observation=saved['observation'],
            state_exact=False,observation_exact=False)
        result['resumed_inputs'].append(entry)
        b=base64.b64decode(saved['state_base64'],validate=True)
        try:
            interval._restore(c.e,np.frombuffer(b,dtype='<f8').copy(),H)
            entry['actual_observation']=asdict(c.e._observation())
            entry['observation_exact']=json.dumps(entry['actual_observation'],sort_keys=True)==json.dumps(saved['observation'],sort_keys=True)
        finally:
            entry['actual_state_base64']=raw(primary(c.e));entry['actual_time_s']=float(c.d.time)
            entry['state_exact']=primary(c.e)==b and float(c.d.time)==saved['time_s']
        require(entry['state_exact'] and entry['observation_exact'],'retained physical/sensory restore differs')
        c.work=tuple(saved['work']);c.supply=saved['remaining_supply_j']
        c.impulses={tuple(v['pair']):(np.asarray(v['force']),np.asarray(v['couple']),v['force_path'],v['couple_path']) for v in saved['impulses']}
        lane.last_attempt=saved['last_attempt'];lane.release=saved['release']
        return lane

    def events(lane):
        old=prior[lane.label]
        s,b=paths(lane.events,old['sequence'][-1])
        return dict(time_s=float(lane.c.d.time),sequence=tuple(old['sequence'][:-1])+s,
                    brackets=old['brackets']+b)

    def compare(now,kind,event_override=None):
        a,b=(l.c for l in lanes)
        require(float(a.d.time)==float(b.d.time)==now,'comparison clocks differ')
        ep=[events(l) for l in lanes] if event_override is None else event_override
        operands=[dict(snapshot=interval._snapshot(c.e),work=c.work,impulses=c.impulses,
            sequence=e['sequence'],brackets=e['brackets']) for c,e in zip((a,b),ep)]
        verdict=radau.trajectory_agreement(b.e,*operands,now)
        row=dict(time_s=now,kind=kind,verdict=verdict)
        result['comparisons'].append(row)
        errors.compare(a,b,a.snapshot(),b.snapshot(),now*1e6)
        if not verdict['passed'] or errors.first_failure is not None or errors.unresolved_touch['samples']:
            # Retain primary operands before any fallible sensory projection.
            failed=dict(event_states=ep,states=[dict(label=l.label,
                raw_state=raw(primary(l.c.e)),time_s=float(l.c.d.time),
                work=l.c.work,supply_j=l.c.supply,
                impulses=radau._record_impulses(l.c.impulses)) for l in lanes])
            result['failed_operands']=failed
            for lane,state in zip(lanes,failed['states']):
                state['observation']=asdict(lane.c.e._observation())
            raise ValueError('paired retained-history accuracy/event correspondence failure')
        result['last_common_time_s']=now
        return ep

    def release():
        # An exact external bench command, not a bodily decision or elapsed step.
        require(all(float(l.c.d.time)==.25 and l.release is None for l in lanes),'release predecessor differs')
        ep=compare(.25,'before_release')
        record=dict(time_s=.25,completed=False,lanes=[])
        result['release_records'].append(record)
        before=[(primary(l.c.e),float(l.c.m.opt.timestep)) for l in lanes]
        try:
            for lane,(raw_before,dt) in zip(lanes,before):
                c=lane.c
                row=dict(label=lane.label,before_base64=raw(raw_before),before_domain=plain_domain(interval._snapshot(c.e)['domain']),
                         effort_before=float(c.d.ctrl[c.motor]),effort_after=0.,work_before=c.work,supply_before=c.supply)
                record['lanes'].append(row)
                c.d.ctrl[c.motor]=0.
                changed=primary(c.e)
                row['command_state_base64']=raw(changed)
                try:
                    probe.forward(c.e);c.e._check()
                    row['after_domain']=plain_domain(interval._snapshot(c.e)['domain'])
                finally:
                    row['after_base64']=raw(primary(c.e));row['after_time_s']=float(c.d.time)
                require(primary(c.e)==changed and float(c.d.time)==.25,'release advanced time or changed integration state')
                require(c.work==row['work_before'] and c.supply==row['supply_before'],'zero-time release changed work ledger')
            new_events=[dict(time_s=.25,sequence=(row['after_domain'],),brackets=[])
                        for row in record['lanes']]
            compare(.25,'after_release',new_events)
        except BaseException:
            for lane,(raw_before,dt) in zip(lanes,before):
                interval._restore(lane.c.e,np.frombuffer(raw_before,dtype='<f8').copy(),dt)
            record['physical_rollback_exact']=all(primary(l.c.e)==v[0] for l,v in zip(lanes,before))
            raise
        # All fallible force/sensory checks passed; commit observer metadata.
        # Retain raw changed-event operands once before resetting the segment.
        result['closed_segments'].append(dict(start_s=result['segment_start_s'],end_s=.25,
            event_states=ep,changed_event_rows={l.label:l.events for l in lanes}))
        for lane,row,new in zip(lanes,record['lanes'],new_events):
            prior[lane.label]=new;lane.events=[]
            lane.release=dict(time_s=.25,before_base64=row['before_base64'],
                              after_base64=row['command_state_base64'])
        result['segment_start_s']=.25;record['completed']=True

    try:
        controls=archived_controls();control=controls[100]
        require(control['phases'][0]['phase']=='load' and control['phases'][1]['phase']=='release'
                and control['phases'][1]['effort_nm']==0.,'archived bench inputs changed')
        if RESUME is None:
            p0,p1,p2=[load(n,s) for n,s in PARENTS.items()]
            require(p2['completed'] and p2['failure'] is None and p2['first_failure'] is None,
                    'finer prefix not accepted')
            require(p2['endpoint_impulse_comparisons'][-1]['verdict']['passed'],'finer terminal comparison absent')
            saved=[next(l for l in p1['lanes'] if l['label']=='half'),p2['lane']]
            a=restore(saved[0],'half',H/2,control);b=restore(saved[1],'quarter',H/4,control)
            require(saved[0]['time_s']==saved[1]['time_s']==p2['event_state']['time_s'],'prefix clocks differ')
            initial=next(i for i in p0['initial_inputs'] if i['label']=='half')['domain']
            old=next(l for l in p0['lanes'] if l['label']=='half')['events']+saved[0]['events']
            sequence,brackets=paths(old,initial)
            prior['half']=dict(time_s=saved[0]['time_s'],sequence=sequence,brackets=brackets)
            prior['quarter']=dict(p2['event_state'])
            prior['quarter']['sequence']=tuple(plain_domain(x) for x in prior['quarter']['sequence'])
            result['prior_sample_count']=p2['prior_sample_count']+len(p2['samples'])
            result['prior_cpu_seconds']=p2['prior_cpu_seconds']+p2['cpu_seconds']
            metrics=p2['metrics']
        else:
            parent=load(*RESUME)
            require(parent['schema']==SCHEMA_OUT and not parent['completed'] and parent['first_failure'] is None,
                    'parent is not a bounded unfinished paired history')
            require(parent['failure']['type']=='RuntimeError' and parent['failure']['error']==
                    'bounded admitted-motion diagnostic exhausted; qualification incomplete','parent stopped for non-budget failure')
            require(all(r['verdict']['passed'] for r in parent['comparisons']),'parent comparisons failed')
            require(all(r['completed'] for r in parent['release_records']),'parent has incomplete command release')
            require(len(parent['lanes'])==2 and
                    [l['label'] for l in parent['lanes']]==['half','quarter'],
                    'parent independent lane roster differs')
            result.update(segment_start_s=parent['segment_start_s'],closed_segments=parent['closed_segments'],
                release_records=parent['release_records'],last_common_time_s=parent['last_common_time_s'],
                prior_sample_count=parent['prior_sample_count']+len(parent['samples']),
                prior_cpu_seconds=parent['prior_cpu_seconds']+parent['cpu_seconds'])
            for saved,label,nominal in zip(parent['lanes'],('half','quarter'),(H/2,H/4)):
                last=saved['last_attempt']
                require(last is not None and ((last['completed'] and last['end_s']==saved['time_s']) or
                    (not last['completed'] and last['rollback_exact'] and last['start_s']==saved['time_s']
                     and last['predecessor_base64']==saved['state_base64'] and last['supply_j']==saved['remaining_supply_j'])),
                    'saved lane lacks completed/rolled-back custody')
                restore(saved,label,nominal,control)
                prior[label]=dict(parent['event_states'][label])
                prior[label]['sequence']=tuple(plain_domain(x) for x in prior[label]['sequence'])
                require(prior[label]['time_s']==saved['time_s'],'saved event clock differs')
            metrics=parent['metrics']
        require(all(v['status']==('UNQUALIFIED' if k=='intrinsic_couple_impulse' else 'PASS') for k,v in metrics.items()),
                'prior evaluated accuracy failed')
        errors.groups={k:v['channels'] for k,v in metrics.items() if 'channels' in v}
        touch=metrics['local_tactile_correspondence']
        errors.unresolved_touch={k:touch[k] for k in ('samples','first','last')}
        errors.matched_touch_points=touch['matched_points'];errors.empty_touch_samples=touch['both_empty_samples']
        errors.couple_impulse=metrics['intrinsic_couple_impulse']['pairs']
        for lane in lanes:
            require(prior[lane.label]['sequence'][-1]==plain_domain(interval._snapshot(lane.c.e)['domain']),
                    'restored event domain differs from actual mechanics')
        if float(lanes[0].c.d.time)==float(lanes[1].c.d.time):
            compare(float(lanes[0].c.d.time),'restored_control')
        for boundary in (.25,.5):
            while min(float(l.c.d.time) for l in lanes)<boundary:
                budget()
                times=[float(l.c.d.time) for l in lanes];begin=min(times)
                stop=max(times) if max(times)>begin else next_sample(begin,boundary)
                require(begin<stop<=boundary,'continuation target differs')
                for lane in lanes:
                    if float(lane.c.d.time)<stop:lane.advance(stop)
                    else:require(float(lane.c.d.time)==stop,'saved lane ahead of target')
                compare(stop,'settled')
                result['samples'].append(stop)
                if len(result['samples'])%100==0:
                    print('PROGRESS',json.dumps(dict(time_s=stop,attempts=attempts,
                        cpu_seconds=time.process_time()-started_cpu)),flush=True)
            if boundary==.25 and all(l.release is None for l in lanes):release()
        require(all(float(l.c.d.time)==.5 and l.release is not None for l in lanes),'full load/release not completed')
        budget();result['completed']=True
    except Exception as error:
        result['failure']=dict(type=type(error).__name__,error=str(error),traceback=traceback.format_exc(limit=8))
    finally:
        mj.mj_forward=native_forward
        for lane in lanes:
            try:result['event_states'][lane.label]=events(lane)
            except Exception as error:result['event_states'][lane.label]=dict(unavailable=True,error=repr(error))
        result.update(lanes=[l.record() for l in lanes],metrics=errors.result(),first_failure=errors.first_failure,
            attempts=attempts,calls=probe.calls,call_accounting=audit,native_seconds=probe.native_seconds,
            observed_primitive_seconds=probe.transition_seconds,observer_seconds=probe.observer_seconds,
            cpu_seconds=time.process_time()-started_cpu,wall_seconds=time.perf_counter()-started_wall)
    print(json.dumps(encode(result)),flush=True)


def run():
    helper=Path('/tmp/a1-loaded-contact-run-20260927.py').read_bytes()
    require(hashlib.sha256(helper).hexdigest()=='a75f28ae491567cd010e5ff4d50118d1b2cbe41298c9e9867055f3432acabb91','runner changed')
    exec(compile(helper.decode().split('\nassert Path.cwd()==ROOT and not TARGET.exists()',1)[0],
                 '<reviewed operational envelope>','exec'),globals())
    global FP
    require(len(sys.argv)==3,'fingerprint and proof hash required')
    FP,proof_sha=sys.argv[1:];target=ROOT/'docs/evidence'/TARGET_NAME
    require(Path.cwd()==ROOT and not target.exists(),'wrong workspace or existing receipt')
    expected={HERE:proof_sha,ACCEPTED:ACCEPTED_SHA,ABI:ABI_SHA,RADAU:RADAU_SHA,LIB:LIB_SHA,
        ROOT/'native/functional_body/radau.pyx':SOURCE_SHA,
        ROOT/'native/functional_body/interval.pyx':'5d978491164774fc14b803232f00cdc0f9f98f94c7eeb8b9c9b5accf036f03e6'}
    for name,sha in PARENTS.items():expected[ROOT/'docs/evidence'/name]=sha
    if RESUME is not None:expected[ROOT/'docs/evidence'/RESUME[0]]=RESUME[1]
    for p,s in expected.items():require(hashlib.sha256(p.read_bytes()).hexdigest()==s,str(p))
    fingerprint();pre=health();print('PRE_HEALTH',json.dumps(pre),flush=True);require_health(pre)
    env=dict(os.environ,PYTHONDONTWRITEBYTECODE='1',OPENBLAS_NUM_THREADS='1',OMP_NUM_THREADS='1',MKL_NUM_THREADS='1',
        LD_LIBRARY_PATH=str(LIB.parent),GUALA_RADAU_PROOF_ABI=str(RADAU),
        PYTHONPATH=str(ABI.parent)+':'+str(RADAU.parent)+':/tmp/guala-body-optics-native.U8I8en/python:/tmp/guala-body-native.pnUH8P/lib/python3.11/site-packages:.:tests:tools')
    offline="import socket\ndef deny(*a,**k): raise RuntimeError('offline child forbids network')\nsocket.socket.connect=deny\nsocket.socket.connect_ex=deny\nsocket.socket.sendto=deny\n"
    args=[str(HERE),'--child']+([] if RESUME is None else ['--resume',*RESUME])
    code=offline+"import json,resource,runpy,sys\nsys.argv="+repr(args)+"\ntry:runpy.run_path("+repr(str(HERE))+",run_name='__main__')\nfinally:\n r=resource.getrusage(resource.RUSAGE_SELF)\n print('CHILD_RESOURCES',json.dumps(dict(cpu_seconds=r.ru_utime+r.ru_stime,maxrss_kib=r.ru_maxrss)))\n"
    execution=None;out='';operational_error=None
    try:execution,out=child(code,env,'paired-saved-load-release')
    except Exception as error:operational_error=repr(error)
    finally:
        post=health();print('POST_HEALTH',json.dumps(post),flush=True)
    health_error=None
    try:
        require_health(post);require(pre['service']==post['service'],'production release changed')
        require(pre['observation']['identity']==post['observation']['identity'] and
            post['observation']['live_tick']>=pre['observation']['live_tick'],'production continuity changed')
    except Exception as error:health_error=repr(error)
    fingerprint()
    for p,s in expected.items():require(hashlib.sha256(p.read_bytes()).hexdigest()==s,str(p))
    packed=result=resources=None;progress=[]
    for line in out.splitlines():
        if line.startswith('CHILD_RESOURCES '):resources=json.loads(line.split(' ',1)[1]);continue
        if line.startswith('PROGRESS '):progress.append(json.loads(line.split(' ',1)[1]));continue
        if not line.startswith('{'):continue
        value=json.loads(line);b=zlib.decompress(base64.b64decode(value['payload_zlib_base64'],validate=True))
        require(len(b)==value['raw_bytes'] and hashlib.sha256(b).hexdigest()==value['raw_sha256'],'child payload differs')
        decoded=json.loads(b);require(packed is None and decoded['schema']==SCHEMA_OUT,'child schema/duplicate differs')
        packed,result=value,decoded
    measured=bool(execution and execution['exit_code']==0 and not execution['timed_out'] and result and resources
                  and operational_error is None and health_error is None)
    passed=bool(measured and result['completed'] and result['failure'] is None and result['cpu_seconds']<50. and result['attempts']<30000)
    receipt=dict(schema=SCHEMA_OUT+'.receipt',candidate_fingerprint=FP,source_sha256={str(p):s for p,s in expected.items()},
        production_pre=pre,production_post=post,execution=execution,child_resources=resources,
        operational_error=operational_error,health_error=health_error,measurement_recorded=measured,
        diagnostic_completed=passed,raw_measurement=packed,progress=progress,diagnostic_source=HERE.read_text(),
        child_output_when_no_measurement=out if packed is None else None,mounted=False,full_body_qualification=False,
        resource_limits=dict(affinity_cores=2,address_space_bytes_per_process=1024**3,cpu_seconds_per_process=60,
            wall_seconds_per_group=90,aggregate_memory_enforced=False))
    content=json.dumps(receipt,sort_keys=True,indent=2)+'\n'
    patch='*** Begin Patch\n*** Add File: '+str(target)+'\n'+'\n'.join('+'+s for s in content.splitlines())+'\n*** End Patch\n'
    subprocess.run(['apply_patch'],input=patch,text=True,check=True)
    summary={k:result[k] for k in ('completed','failure','first_failure','attempts','calls','cpu_seconds','last_common_time_s')} if result else dict(no_measurement=True)
    if result:summary.update(samples=len(result['samples']),lanes=[dict(label=l['label'],time_s=l['time_s']) for l in result['lanes']])
    print('RESULT',json.dumps(summary),flush=True);sys.exit(0 if passed else 1)


if __name__=='__main__':
    if '--resume' in sys.argv:
        at=sys.argv.index('--resume');require(at==len(sys.argv)-3,'resume arguments must be terminal')
        name,sha=sys.argv[at+1:]
        require(Path(name).name==name and name.startswith('FB-01aj-paired-load-release') and name.endswith('.json')
            and len(sha)==64 and all(c in '0123456789abcdef' for c in sha),'invalid resume custody')
        RESUME=(name,sha);TARGET_NAME='FB-01aj-paired-load-release-'+sha[:12]+'.json';del sys.argv[at:]
    if sys.argv[1:]==['--child']:diagnostic()
    else:run()
